(nga )༄༅/ /'jam dpal dkar po ma ti'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul lag len rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /shes bya kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas/

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// 'jam dpal dkar po ma ti'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul lag len rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs// shes bya kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas// mngon gyur bar du mtha' klas shes bya'i gnas// snang byed bla ma 'jam dbyangs tha mi dad// lhag pa'i lha ru bsnyen tshul yi ger 'god// de'ang gang zag dbang thob cing khyad par 'di'i rjes gnang dang man ngag legs par mnos pas rang gzhan gyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal ba'i phyir slob dpon ma ti nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul la/ dang por mtshams la 'jug pa'i dus gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs bzang bar sngon byung ston pas bdud btul ba'i dus dang bstun na srod kyi dang po mun rub bam/ yang na shes rab rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyis snga dro nyi ma shar 'phral nas 'jug ste/ de'i sbyor ba ni gtor ma sha chang gi dri ma med pa zlum gtor mtheb skyu bzhis bskor ba rgyan ldan bshams/ de'i mdun du nyer spyod rnams sgreng tshar bshams/ 'jam dkar gyi sku bris 'bur gang rigs de'i thad kyi gyang logs su dgram/ rang nyid kha shar ram lho ru phyogs par bsdad/ gnas khang gis stabs ma bde na kha shar bltas su yod par bsam pas chog rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bkra shis kyi me tog snod bcas dang*/ chab len pa'i bum pa'ang 'dus bya// de nyin gyi sngon 'gro la cha gsum gtor ma bshams nas gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar cha gsum cho gas btang nas/ mtshams bcad de sgo rtsar tho 'dzugs byas/ de nas brtsams te mtshams 'og 'jug dgos bzhi lnga tsam lta bu dgos nges min pa mang po mi 'jug de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las sogs nas shabda swā hā zhes dang dharm+ma ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i bar spyi ltar byas/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul bla ma dang 'jam dpal gnyis su med pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs rnams gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod de skyabs 'gro byed par bsams nas/

mar gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma sogs skyabs 'gro dang por zhag gnyis gsum tsam la skyabs su 'gro ba thun re la'ang ci tsam nus pa blo dang 'dres nges pa bya/ de nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gcig brjod pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim pas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa bsal sogs sems bskyed pa lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi swa bhā wa sogs nas/ yig 'bru rnams g.yon du 'khor bas sdig sgrib rnams sangs sangs dag par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar 'don bsgom bya/ de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i dmigs pa de nyid dang bcas te sngags bzla ba'i sgang la ngag bcad dam par bya/ gsol ja bzhes 'phral chab len pa sogs gtsang sbra bya/ thun bsdu ba na bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis mchod/ shin tu dkar ba'i sogs nas shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ snga thun dgongs thun gang rung cig gi mthar gtor ma 'bul te/ de'ang gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin brlabs/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ bris sku sogs kyi rten swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las rgya mtsho chen po dkar po dkar zhing sogs/

rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar brjod/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas brtsams te oṃ wā kye daṃ nā ma zhes pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs ka'i a yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas de la gnyis su med par bstims nas/ de la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arya mañdzu shrī i daṃ ba lyā di kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga sogs kyis phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs nas arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ shin tu dkar ba'i mdangs ldan sogs kyis bstod

spro na mtshan yang dag par brjod pas kyang bstod/ cing gsol 'debs sngar bzhin bya/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gzugs kyi rten 'di la bskyed cing bstim pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hās me tog gtor/ de nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing*/ bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste zhes shlau ka gcig gis smon lam btab la/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ thun mtshams thams cad du bdag nyid 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// des thun gcig song*/ thun gnyis pa la skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bzlas pa'i mjug gi mchod bstod gsol ba btab rjes su/ gtor bsngo dor nas/ dge ba bsngo ba la 'jug go /thun gsum pa la'ang de dang 'dra ste de ltar na thun gsum byed pa'i lugs yin/ gal te thun bzhi byung na shin tu legs te/ tho rangs nas nyi dros bar thun dang po/ de rjes nas nyin phyed bar thun gnyis pa/ phyed yol nas dgongs mo'i bar thun gsum pa/ de nas srod thun bar thun bzhi pa byed pa yin no// de lta bu'i sgo nas grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag drug bya bar bshad kyang thog ma'i bsnyen pa zla ba gcig la sngags 'bum phrag bcu sogs gang 'gro dang gsang sngags nus pa 'byin byed sbyin sreg dang bcas pa grub na legs pa yin no// 'di'i sgrub skor ma tis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung rgya ston dang chag lo tsā dang mkhan chen buddha lakṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i sgrub yig sogs mang du snang ngo*// lha mchog 'jam dpal ji ltar bsnyen pa'i thabs// rnam gsal bgyis pa'i bsod nams sems can khams// blo gros me long dwangs par gtsug lag gzugs// brgya phrag 'gog med 'char ba'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes 'jam dpal dkar po ma ti'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul lag len rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di'ang ldan yul shod kyi sa 'dzin mgon po rnam rgyal ba'i gsung gis bskul 'phral bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// 'jam dpal dkar po ma ti'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs paṇa chen ma ti'i zhabs// mkhas mchog shākya shrī dang byang chub dpal// bde ba dpal dang sangs rgyas gzhon nu can// bsod nams shes rab mkhan chen shes rab mgon// shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen kun dga' bzang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang ratna wardha dang*// dkon mchog lhun grub nam mkha' dpal bzang po// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs tshul khrims lhun grub sogs// byin rlabs gdams ngag dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// 'jam dpal la sogs yi dam rgyal ba sras// bstan srung bcas la phyag 'tshal bsnyen pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan las nyon sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas// gzhung lugs kun shes 'chad rtsom rtsod pa la// thogs pa med pa'i blo gros 'od brgya pa'i// phan bde'i snang bas bstan 'gror khyab par mdzod// ces pa 'jam dpal dkar po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma 'od dpag med// sangs rgyas kun 'dus yi dam spyan ras gzigs// las bzhi kun sgrub mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste// khams gsum kun tu gzigs pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// bdag la gson gshin phyogs nas gang byin pa'i// bsam sbyor dge bas nyer mtshon rang gzhan gyi// sgo gsum gyis bsags dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus// dmigs yul de des thogs drangs sems can rnams// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gror mi skye bar// dal 'byor lus thob byang chub spyod spyad pas// gru 'dzin bde ba can sogs sangs rgyas zhing*// skye ba'i smon lam 'bras bu smin par shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam bsdus pa bde ldan 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gi kha ton du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
